# genesyscloud_speechandtextanalytics_settings (Data Source)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/data-sources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Data source for Genesys Cloud organization Speech & Text Analytics settings. This is a singleton, so no arguments are required.

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this data source. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/speechandtextanalytics/settings](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-speechandtextanalytics-settings)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `speechAndTextAnalytics:settings:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `speech-and-text-analytics`
* `speech-and-text-analytics:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "genesyscloud_speechandtextanalytics_settings" "settings" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `agent_empathy_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the Agent Empathy setting is enabled.
- `default_program_id` (String) The ID of the default program used for topic detection.
- `expected_dialects` (List of String) The list of expected dialects, e.g. en-US.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `text_analytics_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether text analytics is enabled.
